FULL TEXT:
Main (Phase-II) Exam Notice for the post of Jr. Clerks under Direct
Recruitment Quota.
In reference to online applications received for the posts of Jr. Clerks under Direct
Recruitment quota in the Bank, the Roll Numbers of successful candidates who qualified for
main examination (in prescribed ratio) were uploaded on Bank’s website www.hpscb.com
on 20.06.2024 for information of all concerned.
All the candidates declared successful in Preliminary examination are informed that online
MAIN (PHASE-II) EXAMINATION for said posts has been scheduled to be conducted by
IBPS on 28TH July, 2024. The candidates are advised to download their call letters for ibid
online exam from the link provided on Bank’s website www.hpscb.com .
The candidates are also advised to read and follow all the instructions given in their call
letters and information handout, meticulously, to avoid any inconvenience at examination
venue.
Date: 18.07.2024 ---sd---
Place: Shimla Managing Director
